invariant: A structural contract repair may change patterns, cardinalities, limits and smoke arguments, but never the ruler: per role the validation_profile and executable flag are unchanged, allow_extra_files never flips False->True, entrypoints are unchanged. Any such change is rejected as workspace-contract-repair:VALIDATOR_WEAKENED with one diagnostic row per weakening (loc + before -> after) and the repair rolls back; tightening (allow_extra_files True->False) passes. The prompt states the same rule and that content diagnostics (HTML external resource, format failures) belong to the producer. Safety/false-success exception: a downgraded profile made an offline-violation diagnostic vanish while the delivered bytes still referenced a CDN.
